messages:
mike: Alert: microburst of 503s on embeddings ingest for last 6m, SLO slipping. Root cause points to a backpressure threshold regression introduced in 3.1.0. I built 3.1.1-hotfix that reverts the threshold tweak. Change window ends in 20m, requesting expedited deploy. @sre-oncall @release-captain

sre-oncall: Share quick smoke steps and rollback criteria. I'll only approve if we have an automated rollback on errors or latency.

tara: Image sha and smoke commands please. Confirm no DB/index changes.

mike: Image `redwood/emb:3.1.1-hotfix` sha=`a1b2c3d4`. No DB changes. Smoke commands: `curl -sf http://embeddings/health` then `python infra/quick_load.py --qps 60 --duration 90 --routes ingest`. Ran in staging, small QPS spike but stable.

ops-bot: Expedited approval requested by mike. Please react with :thumbsup: from 2 leads within 10m to proceed.

ana: :thumbsup:

release-captain: :thumbsup: provisional, assuming auto-rollback thresholds are set.

devkit: Quick note: can we set rollback on "5xx rate > 0.4% absolute for 2m" OR "ingest queue length > 250 for 3m"?

sre-oncall: Good triggers. I'll enable both as auto-rollback rules.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Command accepted: `/deploy start --service=embeddings --image=redwood/emb:3.1.1-hotfix --canary=5% --notes="hotfix revert backpressure tweak"`

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 10 pods (5% traffic). Metrics: 5xx=0.05% vs baseline 0.03%, p95 +12ms. Link: https://deploy.metrics/canary/7167778888

mike: Monitoring traces and queue length.

ana: Canary logs show reduced queue stalls on new pods. Small blip at t+30s then stable.

release-captain: Recommend promote to 30% after 3m hold if stable.

deploy-bot: Promoting canary to 30%...

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. 30% on `redwood/emb:3.1.1-hotfix`. Metrics steady.

sre-oncall: Observability: 5xx returned to baseline on canary subset, queue length lower. Auto-rollback still armed.

mike: Proceed to 100% in 10m if no regressions. I'll start the promote in 7m.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 100% per operator command...

deploy-bot: Swap complete 100% traffic -> `redwood/emb:3.1.1-hotfix`. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to=redwood/emb:3.1.0 --ticket=HOTFIX-8420`

deploy-bot: Note: auto-rollback window will remain open for 15m post-swap.

sre-oncall: Observability dashboard looks good so far. No rising 5xx, ingest queue normal.

mike: Adding short release note and linking PR: https://git.host/release/pull/1501 "Hotfix 3.1.1: revert backpressure threshold causing transient ingest 503s."

ops-bot: Expedited deploy closed by release-captain. Reminder to file RCA if this resurfaces.

ana: Leaving canary logs pinned for 30m for correlation. Good coordination y'all :raised_hands:
